name: Horror: Character Action Clip
description: Video preset for a character clip in the Horror look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second character clip. State the single action, the camera move, and the mood. Keep the character's design identical to the entity's description.
context_prompt: short clip of the character performing one clear action that shows personality, start and end pose readable, horror film still, subject half lost in shadow, something wrong at the edge of the frame, decayed textures, uneasy off-centre composition, low-key lighting, single cold practical light, desaturated palette with one sickly accent colour, fog, slow creeping push-in, long static holds, flicker in practical lights, movement glimpsed in the background
negative_prompt: bright cheerful lighting, cartoon, comedy, clean new surfaces, gore close-up, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
